source_access_note: Same public Medfield / Hillside Village PDF used for the active A-1 single-sheet case. P40-02 tracked the full 9-page plan/elevation set as a multi-plan intake gate; P40-03 promoted it to known_gap after committing a reduced full-run artifact snapshot; P44 promoted it to active recognition benchmark after drawing_understanding began merging sheet_graphs.json evidence.

intended_scope.goal: Capture a real multi-sheet plan/elevation set for expected-inventory and multi-plan artifact benchmarking.
intended_scope.selected_sheet_strategy: Review all pages first, then use selected plan sheets with human-reviewed expected inventory for drawing_understanding, sheet_graphs, and sheet_issues checks.
intended_scope.non_goal: This active recognition row does not claim final multi-plan compliance aggregation.

current_observation.status: P44 merge exposes has_openings=true from sheet_graphs.json count evidence.

promotion_rule: Promoted active in P44 after the full-set benchmark passed with sheet_graphs.json count evidence merged into drawing_understanding. Per-sheet candidate issues remain preview-only.
expected_inventory_authoring_notes: Annotate sheet type and page index for each selected plan sheet.
Record coarse room/opening/corridor/stair/dimension counts with evidence notes.
Record required sheet_graphs page indexes and per-sheet component count ranges.
Record sheet_issues preview expectations separately from primary issues.json because P39 keeps per-sheet issues as candidate preview only.
